What is Glamour?

A European institution built for African creators

Glamour connects Africans to a wider international audience where creativity, daily habits, fashion, culture and lifestyle can become something the world can experience.

From outfits to routines, cuisine, language and interests, Glamour turns everyday expression into a premium digital lifestyle experience.

  • Earn from your lifestyle
  • Showcase African culture to the world
  • Build influence online
  • Monetize creativity with soft life energy
